claim: The accepted QST-ARCI-0001 synthetic-target assessment keeps score and evidence confidence separate across 28 bounded sensitivity cases, with every case remaining research-only and no major grade reversal on the declared perturbations.

provenance.demonstrated_scale: one synthetic target; seven dimensions; 28 bounded perturbations
provenance.fact_summary: Baseline score is 0.685, confidence 0.5225, confidence-adjusted score 0.3579125; four dimensions are missing data and all bounded sensitivity scenarios remain research-only.
provenance.inference_summary: Score/confidence separation survives this declared synthetic sensitivity test and remains useful as a transparent method boundary.
provenance.speculation_summary: Replacing one missing synthetic dimension with traceable benchmark evidence may be more informative than further arbitrary weight tuning.
limitations: No calibrated real-target grade or resource-value claim.
The falsifier is tested only over the declared bounded perturbations.
